title: External calendar fetch failures are now visible
summary: A feed that fails to load (blocked by CORS, not actually public, bad URL, etc.) used to fail completely silently outside the browser console -- Settings > External Calendars now shows a 'Couldn't load: ...' line under any feed that's never successfully returned events.
The direct-fetch and CORS-proxy fallback failures are both reported together instead of only whichever happened last, so it's clearer whether the problem is the feed itself or the proxy.
